SELECT AVG(group_avg_fillcount)
FROM (
  SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS group_avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow
) AS group_averages;
